actions.description: The named ADR/BRD/FDD/Story chain is already accepted and grounded enough (real traceability, testable acceptance criteria, no unresolved prerequisite) to enter the implement-story pipeline (worktree -> contract RED -> SKILL.md -> implement GREEN -> validate -> log -> PR)

The chain has a real, fixable gap -- e.g. acceptance criteria that cannot actually be contract-tested, or missing traceability to an accepted ADR/BRD/FDD -- that must be fixed before this can enter the pipeline
Whether this chain's grounding is actually sufficient to proceed is ambiguous enough that a human should decide directly

metadata.decision_context: Given an already-accepted ADR/BRD/FDD/Story chain, decide whether it is grounded enough to enter the implement-story pipeline -- shape independently converged by ADPA and SocialEngage; full authority only, a learned low-authority version hit a hard entropy ceiling

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
